# STEC Secure

> STEC Secure is Tamil Nadu's premier security technology and automation engineering firm based in Erode, delivering certified 4K CCTV surveillance, smart IoT automation, biometric access control, and emergency security systems.

## Solutions & Services
- [4K CCTV Surveillance Systems](https://stec-secure.vercel.app/services/cctv): High-definition IP and analog CCTV camera surveillance with night vision, AI human detection, remote smartphone monitoring, and continuous local recording.
- [Smart Home IoT Automation](https://stec-secure.vercel.app/services/home-automation): Intelligent lighting, smart switches, voice assistant control, and energy-efficient automation for luxury homes and apartments.
- [Intrusion Burglar Alarms](https://stec-secure.vercel.app/services/burglar-alarm): GSM-backed perimeter intrusion detection, PIR motion sensors, loud sirens, and instant multi-phone emergency dialing.
- [Automatic Gate Automation](https://stec-secure.vercel.app/services/gate-automation): Heavy-duty motorized sliding and swing gate automation with remote control and safety obstacle sensors.
- [Automatic Boom Barriers](https://stec-secure.vercel.app/services/boom-barriers): High-speed barrier gates for apartments, commercial parking layouts, toll plazas, and industrial vehicle checkpoints.
- [Biometric Access Control](https://stec-secure.vercel.app/services/access-control): Fingerprint scanners, facial recognition terminals, RFID keycards, and battery-backed electromagnetic door locks.
- [Smart Video Door Phones](https://stec-secure.vercel.app/services/video-door-phone): High-resolution video doorbells with indoor touch monitors, two-way audio, and remote mobile door unlocking.
- [Hospital Nurse Calling Systems](https://stec-secure.vercel.app/services/nurse-calling): Dedicated wired and wireless emergency call buttons and master nurse station consoles for clinics and hospitals.
- [EPABX & Intercom Systems](https://stec-secure.vercel.app/services/intercom): Multi-line internal communication systems for offices, apartments, educational institutions, and hospitals.
